t002_contract_summary.source_document_policy: Source document identity is project-local, path-safe, snapshot/hash-backed, and distinguishes owner-authored or owner-provided material from generated/tool output.
t002_contract_summary.source_map_policy: Source maps are derived support records with reproducible snapshots, stable segments, exact snapshot hashes, and no destructive normalization or canon status.
t002_contract_summary.offset_policy: Primary first-slice locator is Python string character offsets over the exact UTF-8 decoded snapshot; byte offsets are future/raw-tool mapping support; token and line locators are optional support; all spans are half-open.
t002_contract_summary.evidence_policy: Evidence records support candidate claims only, require source-derived/owner-provided excerpts, bounded confidence, source locator/snapshot/hash data, and do not create truth.
t002_contract_summary.provenance_policy: Extraction run provenance records source snapshots, tool/adapter identity, raw output artifacts, status, warnings, rejection/insufficient-evidence counts, and human review requirement.
t002_contract_summary.raw_output_policy: Raw tool output is stored separately in future extraction folders, is never canon, is not candidate JSON until normalized and validated, and must not write memory/canon/source files.
t002_contract_summary.candidate_boundary: Raw/manual/rule output must normalize through app-owned source locators and evidence records before candidate persistence; candidate confidence cannot bypass owner review.
t002_contract_summary.t003_handoff: Add tests-first contract coverage for future source_map and evidence helpers; tests may be expected red until T004 implements helpers.

source_evidence_policy: Source locators, stable source maps, source hashes, evidence spans, raw output provenance, and candidate normalization must be decided before runtime extraction begins.
